days.title: Flagship Day 1
days.questTitle: The Squatting Citadel of Endless Rows

recommended.title: WARMUP
recommended.body:
Minimum 8:00. Complete 2–3 quality rounds; add an easy round if needed.

3x
15/12 Cal Row 
10 Glute Bridge 
20 Band Pull Apart 
10 Single-leg RDL

*Don't rush your warmup. Execute each movement with a focus on quality. On the machine, you should increase effort each round.

20:00 Max Watt Test
